question: If one substitutes @ with either "+" or "*" (multiplication), in the expression 1@2@3@4@5@6, what is the maximum value that can be derived assuming that the correct order of mathematical operations are followed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2091d3cebaae2d9ac49f0f4a3d14b79d4faccd8b9d4bf391771328b8ce79574e.png] 

In this question substitutes @ with either + or ×, put in the expression 1@2@3@4@5@6 to get maximum value -

Put know that multiply with 1 get same value to get the maximum value we put + near to 1 not ×, and other than 1 we put ×.

1 + 2 × 3 × 4 × 5 × 6 = 1 + 720

 = 721 is the maximum value.

Hence, **"721"** is the correct answer.
